tools.name: actions_config_read
tools.description: Read Actions secrets and variables.

tools.name: actions_config_write
tools.description: Write Actions secrets and variables: upsert, create, update, delete.

tools.name: actions_run_read
tools.description: Read Actions workflows, runs, jobs, logs, and artifacts.

annotations.title: Read Actions workflow, run, job, and artifact data

tools.name: actions_run_write
tools.description: Write Actions runs: dispatch, cancel, rerun a run, one job or only its failed jobs, approve a run, enable or disable a workflow.

annotations.title: Trigger, cancel, rerun, or approve Actions workflows

tools.name: attachment_read
tools.description: Read issue/comment attachments: list metadata, get metadata, or download content.

attachment_id.description: required for get and for download when attachment_uuid is not provided

attachment_uuid.description: attachment UUID for direct download path lookup

comment_id.description: required for comment attachment list/get or comment-scoped metadata lookup

issue_number.description: required for issue attachment list/get or issue-scoped metadata lookup

output_path.description: write the attachment to this exact path

tools.name: compare_commits
tools.description: Compare two refs in a repository: the commits in head that are not in base, and the files they touch.

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Create a new branch in a repository, optionally from a specific source branch (defaults to the repository's default branch).

tools.name: create_commit_status
tools.description: Create a status on a commit, e.g. the result of a CI check or review bot.

tools.name: create_or_update_file
tools.description: Write files in one commit: create, update, rename, delete.

sha.description: existing file SHA, of from_path when renaming (omit to create)

new_branch_name.description: branch to create from branch_name and commit to

annotations.title: Create, update, rename, or delete files

tools.name: create_organization
tools.description: Create a new organization.

tools.name: create_release
tools.description: Create a new release in a repository from a tag, optionally marking it as a draft or pre-release.

tools.name: create_repo
tools.description: Create a new Git repository, optionally under an organization (defaults to the authenticated user's account), with options for visibility, template, license, .gitignore, and initial README.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.description: Create a new Git tag in a repository at a target commit, branch, or existing tag, with an optional annotation message.

tools.name: delete_branch
tools.description: Permanently delete a branch from a repository. This action is destructive and cannot be undone.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from a repository by committing the removal to a branch. Requires the file's current SHA and a commit message.

tools.name: delete_release
tools.description: Delete a release from a repository by its numeric ID. This action is destructive and cannot be undone.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.description: Permanently delete a tag from a repository. This action is destructive and cannot be undone.

tools.name: fork_repo
tools.description: Fork an existing repository into the authenticated user's account or a target organization, optionally under a new name.

tools.name: get_commit
tools.description: Get details for a single commit in a repository by its SHA, optionally with its unified diff.

tools.name: get_commit_status
tools.description: Get the combined status of a commit, branch or tag: the overall state and the latest status per context, e.g. CI checks.

tools.name: get_dir_contents
tools.description: List the entries (files and subdirectories) in a repository directory at a given ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA).

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Get file content and metadata, or list a directory

ref.description: branch, tag, or commit SHA, defaults to the default branch

tools.name: get_gitea_mcp_server_version
tools.description: Get the running version of the Gitea MCP Server itself (not the Gitea instance it connects to).

tools.name: get_latest_release
tools.description: Get the most recent published (non-draft) release in a repository.

tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Get current user

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: Get a release by ID

tools.name: get_repository_tree
tools.description: Get the file tree of a repository at a given ref (SHA, branch, or tag), optionally recursively.

tools.name: get_tag
tools.description: Get details for a single tag in a repository by name.

tools.name: get_user_orgs
tools.description: List current user's organizations

tools.name: issue_read
tools.description: Read issue: details, comments, labels, dependencies, or the users it can be assigned to.

tools.name: issue_write
tools.description: Write issues: create, update, manage comments, labels and dependencies.

dependency_type.description: issue_number is blocked_by or blocking the related issue

annotations.title: Create or update issues, comments, labels, and dependencies

tools.name: label_read
tools.description: Read repo or org labels.

tools.name: label_write
tools.description: Write labels (repo or org): create, edit, delete.

exclusive.description: mutually exclusive with labels of the same scope, e.g. 'priority/'

tools.name: list_branches
tools.description: List all branches in a repository, paginated.

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: List commits in a repository, optionally starting from a specific branch or SHA and filtered to commits touching a given file path.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues in a repository (or pull requests, via the 'type' filter), filterable by state, labels, milestones, users, and update time range.

tools.name: list_my_repos
tools.description: List repositories owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_org_repos
tools.description: List repositories belonging to an organization.

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests in a repository, filterable by state and milestone, with configurable sort order (e.g. recently updated, most commented).

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List releases in a repository, optionally filtered to drafts or pre-releases.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tags in a repository, paginated.

tools.name: milestone_read
tools.description: Read milestones: get one or list.

tools.name: milestone_write
tools.description: Write milestones: create, update, delete.

tools.name: notification_read
tools.description: Read notifications: list (optionally scoped to a repo) or get a thread by ID.

tools.name: notification_write
tools.description: Mark a notification or all notifications as read.

tools.name: package_read
tools.description: Read package registry: list packages (one entry per version, filter via 'q'/'type'), list versions, or get a version.

tools.name: package_write
tools.description: Delete a package version (irreversible).

tools.name: project_read
tools.description: Read projects of owner+repo, org, or your own if neither.

tools.name: project_write
tools.description: Write projects of owner+repo, org, or your own if neither. add_issue also moves between columns, move_issue also sets the position within one.

column_ids.description: for 'move_columns': every column ID of the project, in the new order

sorting.description: 'update_column': column position, -128 to 127; 'move_issue': position in the column, omit to append

tools.name: pull_request_read
tools.description: Read pull request: details, diff, changed files, commits, head commit status, reviews, review comments, discussion comments. Also find the PR for a branch pair or commit, and list who can be asked to review.

review_id.description: for 'get_review'; optional for 'get_review_comments', omit to list all

wait_seconds.description: for 'get_status': seconds to wait while pending, max 45

tools.name: pull_request_review_write
tools.description: Write PR reviews: create, submit, delete, dismiss, reply to and resolve review comments.

body.description: review body, or reply text for 'reply_comment'

comment_id.description: comment ID from 'get_review_comments'; resolve takes the thread's first

tools.name: pull_request_write
tools.description: Write pull requests: create, update, close, reopen, merge, update branch from base, manage reviewers.

head_commit_id.description: expected head SHA for conflict detection

message.description: merge commit message or dismissal reason

annotations.title: Create, update, close, reopen, or merge pull requests

tools.name: rename_branch
tools.description: Rename an existing branch in a repository.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search issues and PRs across repositories

tools.name: search_org_teams
tools.description: Search for teams within an organization by name, optionally including each team's description in the results.

tools.name: search_repos
tools.description: Search for repositories by keyword, with filters for topic/description matching, owner, visibility, archived status, and sort order.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Search for Gitea users by username or full name.

tools.name: timetracking_read
tools.description: Read time tracking: issue times, repo times, active stopwatches, your tracked times.

tools.name: timetracking_write
tools.description: Write time tracking: stopwatches and entries.

tools.name: wiki_read
tools.description: Read wiki: list pages, get content, revision history.

tools.name: wiki_write
tools.description: Write wiki pages: create, update, delete.

annotations.title: Create, update, or delete wiki pages
